english: Of course!
chinese: 当然！

english: Look there!

english: More are on the way.  They come seeking the Orb.

status: draft; Horde term user-confirmed as 魔潮; awaiting live subtitle check

english: But when they got to the High Plateau, there was nowhere left to run.
chinese: 可当他们抵达高原时，前方已无路可逃。

english: Tarrant died without knowing what his choice to stay behind truly meant.
chinese: Tarrant 至死也不知道，留下来究竟意味着什么。

english: He didn't know that the Horde would be only the first of many enemies to plague the Serpent clan.
chinese: 他不知道魔潮只是灵蛇族日后众多灾祸中的第一个。
status: draft; Horde term user-confirmed as 魔潮; awaiting live subtitle check

english: He couldn't know that without the Orb's power to guide them, his descendents would be weak and wicked.
chinese: 他更不可能知道，失去宝珠的指引，后代会变得软弱而邪恶。

english: Did he ever truly have a choice?
chinese: 他真的有过选择吗？

english: It's been a long time, Otomo.
chinese: 好久不见，大友。

english: Don't call me that.
chinese: 别那么叫我。

english: That blade has been my burden for seven years.
chinese: 这把刀，我已背负了七年。

english: If you're so eager to avenge the Serpent, pick it up.
chinese: 若你真想替巨蛇雪恨，就拿起它。

english: Pick it up!
chinese: 拿起来！

english: The bandits worked for Shinja?
chinese: 那些匪徒是替信蛇办事的？

english: Shinja served my father loyally for years.
chinese: 信蛇多年来一直忠心侍奉我父亲。

english: Would he meet with me?
chinese: 他肯见我吗？

english: I didn't come back to repeat my father's mistakes.
chinese: 我回来不是要重犯父亲的错误。

english: I'm going to need Shinja.
chinese: 我会需要信蛇的帮助。

english: It's over.
chinese: 结束了。

english: You know who I am.
chinese: 你知道我是谁。

english: Where is the Serpent's Orb?
chinese: 巨蛇宝珠在哪里？

english: You were charged with protecting the Orb.
chinese: 你本该保护宝珠。

english: Where is it?
chinese: 它在哪里？

english: No - he would have.
chinese: 不——他会的。

english: How has the Swan's Pool survived?
chinese: 天鹅池是怎么幸存下来的？

english: Show me the safest path.
chinese: 带我走最安全的路。

english: I didn't want this.
chinese: 我不想走到这一步。

english: This land never changes.
chinese: 这片土地从来没变过。

english: They've had a lot of practice.
chinese: 他们已经做过很多次了。

english: If it's not us driving them into the ground, it's their warlock masters.
chinese: 不是我们把他们逼入绝境，就是他们的术士主人。

english: For now.
chinese: 暂时如此。

english: You mean you'll rule.
chinese: 你的意思是，你要统治他们。

english: Not the way father fights it.
chinese: 但不能用父亲那套办法。

english: There must be a better way.
chinese: 一定还有更好的办法。

english: I'm not my father, Otomo.
chinese: 我不是我父亲，大友。

english: Not many.
chinese: 不多。

english: Does it matter?
chinese: 那重要吗？

english: No.
chinese: 不。

english: If we push on, we can reach the Swan's Pool by dusk.
chinese: 继续赶路的话，天黑前就能到天鹅池。

english: The thief...why was he here?
chinese: 那个贼……他为什么会来这里？

english: I have.
chinese: 是的。

english: Did he get the Serpent's Orb?
chinese: 他拿到巨蛇宝珠了吗？

english: I've no time for riddles, woman.
chinese: 我没时间听谜语，女人。

english: No.  We'll go to Serpentholm.
chinese: 不。我们去 Serpentholm。

english: I've no quarrel with the other clans.
chinese: 我不想与其他氏族交战。

english: You've seen the Orb.  It's real.
chinese: 你见过宝珠。它是真的。

english: If it's to be done, let's do it quickly.
chinese: 既然要做，就快点动手。

english: Let's teach this upstart clan a lesson.
chinese: 给这个新起的氏族一点教训。

english: I see it.
chinese: 我看见了。

english: It's not the Lotus clan.
chinese: 不是莲花族。

english: When the Orb wakes, so does the Dragon.
chinese: 宝珠醒来，神龙也会醒来。

english: He's telling us to hurry.
chinese: 他要我们快走。

english: It's not called the Dragon's Spire for nothing.
chinese: 龙之尖塔可不是白叫这个名字的。

english: Keep the men moving.
chinese: 让大家继续前进。

english: We won't stop again tonight.
chinese: 今夜我们不再停下。

english: Serpentholm.
chinese: Serpentholm。

english: It's the Orb they're after, not me.
chinese: 他们要的是宝珠，不是我。

english: The key to Serpentholm.
chinese: 通往 Serpentholm 的关键。

english: I made new friends while I was away.
chinese: 我离开时结识了新朋友。

english: Where are you, Serpent?
chinese: 巨蛇，你在哪里？

english: Show yourself, old man!
chinese: 现身吧，老头！

english: You'll not hide behind your geisha tonight!
chinese: 今夜你别想躲在艺妓身后！

english: Whether I'm second son or tenth, I'll make you hear me!
chinese: 不管我是次子还是第十子，你都得听我说！

english: Wake up!
chinese: 醒醒！

english: (gasps)
chinese: （倒吸一口气）

english: And the one who stole the Orb?
chinese: 偷走宝珠的人在哪里？

english: But you lost him.
chinese: 可你把他跟丢了。

english: I know.
chinese: 我知道。

english: It's what killed the Serpent.
chinese: 就是它害死了巨蛇。

english: It doesn't matter anymore.
chinese: 现在已经无所谓了。

english: Look.
chinese: 看。

english: The Dragon and the Orb are one.
chinese: 神龙与宝珠本为一体。

english: You never looked.
chinese: 你从来没有认真看过。

english: It's not.
chinese: 并非如此。

english: The Orb was only half of Tarrant's power.
chinese: 宝珠只承载了 Tarrant 一半的力量。

english: No.
chinese: 不。

english: I have to go to the Dragon's Spire.
chinese: 我得去龙之尖塔。

english: No.  I need you here.
chinese: 不。我需要你留在这里。

english: Let Shinja contain the Lotus and Wolf if he can.
chinese: 信蛇若有本事，就让他拖住莲花族和恶狼族。

english: I seek the Serpent's Orb.
chinese: 我在寻找巨蛇宝珠。

english: The thief was not of the Lotus.
chinese: 偷走它的人不是莲花族。

english: Tarrant used the Orb to break the world.
chinese: Tarrant 曾用宝珠让世界破碎。

english: But...
chinese: 可是……

english: The land must be healed.
chinese: 这片土地必须恢复生机。

english: Without the Orb, how do I repair the damage my clan has done?
chinese: 没有宝珠，我该怎么修复本族造成的伤害？

english: What evil?
chinese: 什么邪恶？

english: Wait...where will I find you?
chinese: 等等……我该去哪里找你？

english: The dragon's time is over.
chinese: 神龙的时代已经过去了。

english: We shouldn't have gone to him.
chinese: 我们不该去见他。

english: Shinja.
chinese: 信蛇。

english: Cut him down.
chinese: 杀了他。

english: We've been betrayed.
chinese: 他们背叛了我们。

english: No.  The village nearby will help us.
chinese: 不。附近的村子会帮我们。

english: The Lotus will find no friends here.
chinese: 莲花族在这里找不到帮手。

english: We stay and fight.
chinese: 我们留下来战斗。

english: Sorry, old friend.
chinese: 抱歉，老朋友。

english: Make it happen.
chinese: 去办吧。

english: Kazan!
chinese: Kazan！

english: Burn Serpentholm.  Burn it to the ground.
chinese: 烧掉 Serpentholm。把它烧成平地。

english: There is no Serpent.
chinese: 巨蛇已不复存在。

english: There's only the Dragon.
chinese: 只剩神龙。

english: Wolf refugees.
chinese: 恶狼族的难民。

chinese: 恶狼族已经不是敌人了。
status: draft; later Kenji arc; not game-tested

chinese: 即使在我父亲的时代，那些土地也保持独立。

english: The plateaus to the east are holy ground and the western province was granted to the ninja.
chinese: 东边的高原是圣地，西边的行省则赐给了忍者。

chinese: 忍者曾为莲花族效力，也许知道他们的秘密。

english: The Dragon was right.
chinese: 神龙说得对。
status: draft; later Kenji arc; not game-tested

status: draft; later Kenji arc; not game-tested

english: I am Kenji, Lord of the Dragon clan.
chinese: 我是神龙族领主健治。

english: For years, his descendants cowered behind their stone walls, hating each other and fearing the dark.
chinese: 多年来，他的后代躲在石壁后，互相憎恨，又惧怕黑暗。

english: They never understood that even in the very heart of Serpentholm, shadows lurked in every corner.

chinese: 黑暗永远都在外面，想让我们感到恐惧。

chinese: 但我们不会再躲藏。

chinese: 这片土地将团结一心，迎接未来。

chinese: 我的家园。他们的田地、牲口、女儿和儿子——全都属于我。

chinese: 这是灵蛇族的土地。

chinese: 放在我手里更安全。

chinese: 我父亲把西边沼泽交给忍者，就是为了让他们远离圣地。

chinese: 两个世纪以来，我的族人一直藏身，求神龙保护。

english: Shh.
chinese: 嘘。

english: It won't be so pretty once the Diseased Ones are through with it.

english: You have news.

status: draft; v42 Lotus entry38; not game-tested

english: Good.

english: And what is this I hear of peasants marching under the Serpent banner?

english: And where is his head?

english: He angered me.

english: You didn't tell me you'd left one of Oja's sons alive.

english: Gone so soon?

english: You've grown up.

english: Where's the young pup I once caught sulking behind the curtains in the Serpent's throne room?

english: Also gone.

english: Perhaps we've both grown up, Kenji.
chinese: 或许我们都长大了，健治。

english: If you want to live, the war ends here.
chinese: 想活命的话，这场战争就到此为止。

english: The Orb is ours.

english: You know him?

status: draft; v42 Lotus entry38; not game-tested

english: I'm giving you a chance to walk away, boy.

status: draft; v42 Lotus entry38; not game-tested

english: This is Lotus land now.
chinese: 这里现在是莲花族的土地。

english: At last - free of corruption!
chinese: 终于摆脱腐化了！
status: draft; v42 Lotus entry38; not game-tested

english: Now I am whole!
chinese: 现在我完整了！

english: You're too late, Serpent!
chinese: 太迟了，蛇族人！
status: draft; v42 Lotus entry38; not game-tested

english: The Lotus would die rather than bow to your kind again!
chinese: 莲花族宁死也不会再向你们臣服！

english: Kenji!
chinese: 健治！
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: We thought you were dead.
chinese: 我们以为你死了。

english: I've waited seven years to serve you, Lord Oja.
chinese: Oja 大人，我等了七年，只希望能为你效力。

english: He saved our lives!
chinese: 他救了我们的命！

english: He doesn't speak for the village.
chinese: 他不能代表整个村子说话。

english: The Serpent's Son will take tea in my house.
chinese: 灵蛇之子，请到我家坐坐。

english: He rules the provinces to the north, and would rule this one too if he could.
chinese: 他统治着北方的行省；若有机会，也会统治这里。

english: He seeks to rebuild the clan, but his methods are...questionable.
chinese: 他想重建氏族，但他的方法……令人质疑。

english: He's tasted power, and won't give it up easily.
chinese: 他已经尝到权力的好处，不会轻易放手。

english: But Shinja only rules because no one else will stand against the other clans.
chinese: 可信蛇能掌权，只因无人敢站出来对抗其他氏族。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: Wolf and Lotus are tearing what's left of your father's empire apart.
chinese: 恶狼族和莲花族正在瓜分你父亲残存的帝国。

english: The people need a leader with Oja blood.
chinese: 人民需要一位拥有 Oja 家族血统的领袖。

english: Then you'll have to beat him.
chinese: 那你就得打败他。

english: Shinja rules two provinces from an old Serpent fort, here.
chinese: 信蛇从这里的一座灵蛇族旧堡垒统治着两个行省。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: His tax collectors take most of what this village has...
chinese: 他派人收走了这个村子的大部分东西……

english: ...while his hired archers haunt the eastern road, stealing what little remains.
chinese: ……雇来的弓箭手又盘踞在东边道路，抢走仅剩的一点。

english: Break Shinja's forces and he'll lose his will to fight.
chinese: 击溃信蛇的部队，他就会失去斗志。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: We have no soldiers, but the villagers stand ready to serve.
chinese: 我们没有士兵，但村民们愿意效力。

english: What shall we do?
chinese: 我们该怎么办？

english: And yet you kept fighting.
chinese: 可你还是坚持战斗。

english: Show respect!
chinese: 放尊重点！

english: Lord Oja would never have given the Orb to geisha!
chinese: Oja 大人绝不会把宝珠交给艺妓！

english: Every death here today saved two.
chinese: 今天这里每牺牲一人，就救下了两人。

english: No one could ask for more.
chinese: 没人能要求更多了。

english: They fight because they fear the Serpent clan.
chinese: 他们作战，是因为惧怕灵蛇族。

english: There are worse men you could be.
chinese: 你本来可能成为更坏的人。

english: Did you kill him?
chinese: 你杀了他吗？

english: Not to me.
chinese: 对我来说不是。

english: You know the legends.
chinese: 你知道那些传说。

english: He's all we have.
chinese: 他是我们唯一的希望。

english: I've never seen anyone move like that.
chinese: 我从未见过有人那样行动。

english: Impossible!  The Lotus clan tore Serpentholm apart stone by stone searching for the Orb!
chinese: 不可能！莲花族为了寻找宝珠，把 Serpentholm 一砖一石都拆了！

english: He's right, Lord.
chinese: 他说得对，大人。

english: If we abandon the villagers, they'll die.
chinese: 如果抛下村民，他们会死。

english: The Orb has been safe for seven years.
chinese: 宝珠已经安然无恙地藏了七年。

english: Only the geisha know where it is.
chinese: 只有艺妓知道它在哪里。

english: Bring them with us, and the Orb stays safe.
chinese: 带上她们，宝珠就能继续安全地藏着。

english: Smoke from the Dragon's Spire.
chinese: 神龙之塔升起了烟。

english: There's a village there.
chinese: 那里有一个村子。

english: If the Lotus soldiers are pillaging that far south, they've already got Serpentholm.
chinese: 如果莲花族士兵已经抢到那么靠南的地方，Serpentholm 恐怕也已失守。

english: What?
chinese: 什么？

english: The dragon is telling us to hurry.
chinese: 神龙要我们快走。

english: The other clans have come.
chinese: 其他氏族来了。

english: There's a lot of them.
chinese: 他们人很多。

english: A week ago these men were peasant farmers.
chinese: 一周前，这些人还只是种田的农民。

english: You've made warriors out of them, but the Lotus and Wolf soldiers are veterans.
chinese: 你把他们练成了战士，可莲花族和恶狼族的兵都是老手。

english: Better that than seven years spent stealing from the very peasants who trusted us to protect them!
chinese: 总好过七年来一直抢那些信任我们保护他们的农民！

english: That...what is that?
chinese: 那……那是什么？

english: Gone.
chinese: 不见了。

english: We tried to follow...
chinese: 我们试着跟上去……

english: Are you sure?
chinese: 你确定？

english: Why does he want the Orb?
chinese: 他为什么想要宝珠？

english: Shinja...
chinese: 信蛇……
status: draft; confirmed hero name; not game-tested

english: Why did I never see that before?
chinese: 我以前怎么没看出来？

english: He'll come to his senses, Lord.
chinese: 大人，他会想明白的。

english: Let me go with you.
chinese: 让我和你一起去。

english: Kenji said...
chinese: 健治说过……

english: No...the Wolf clan is beaten.
chinese: 不……恶狼族已经败了。

english: The Lotus wizards are the real enemy.
chinese: 莲花族的术士才是真正的敌人。

english: We must not let their army escape back to the high plateau.
chinese: 不能让他们的军队逃回高原。

english: Strike them while their backs are to the sea, and we'll finish them once and for all.
chinese: 趁他们背靠大海时进攻，一举解决他们。

english: I'll live.
chinese: 我会活下去。

english: If you have something to say...
chinese: 你有话就说……

english: Kenji will kill you for this.
chinese: 健治会为此杀了你。

english: Show respect!
chinese: 放尊重点！

english: Even after your father's death, the geisha were thought untouchable...
chinese: 即使在你父亲死后，艺妓仍被视为不可侵犯……

english: The Orb may still be safe.
chinese: 宝珠也许还安全。

english: Don't listen to him, lord - this way is the safest.
chinese: 大人，别听他的。这条路最安全。

english: Even though the Lotus have built an outpost there, the dense woods should mask our passage.
chinese: 虽然莲花族在那里建了前哨，但密林能掩护我们通过。

english: Putting out fires.
chinese: 在救火。

english: This is madness, Kenji.
chinese: 这太疯狂了，健治。

english: We've driven these people from their homes.
chinese: 我们把这些人赶出了家园。

english: You sound like your father.
chinese: 你说话越来越像你父亲了。

english: Serpentholm is a ruin.
chinese: Serpentholm 已成一片荒地。

english: The Lotus wizards tore it down when the Serpent died.
chinese: 巨蛇死时，莲花族术士拆毁了那里。

english: Kenji, it doesn't matter.
chinese: 健治，那不重要。

english: Our enemies thought it was here.
chinese: 我们的敌人以为它在这里。

english: We could push on to Serpentholm.
chinese: 我们可以继续前往 Serpentholm。

english: And the geisha?
chinese: 那艺妓怎么办？

english: What?  We can't...
chinese: 什么？我们不能……

english: But lord...they are many and we are few.
chinese: 可是大人……他们人多，我们人少。

english: Perhaps we should withdraw.
chinese: 或许我们该撤退。

english: Lost.
chinese: 丢了。

english: We tried to follow...
chinese: 我们试着跟上去……
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: It wasn't human.  You saw...
chinese: 那不是人。你也看见了……
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: You're mad!
chinese: 你疯了！
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Can't you see?
chinese: 你还不明白吗？
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: He's turned on his own people!
chinese: 他反过来攻击自己人了！
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: How many more can you kill before the clan is destroyed?
chinese: 氏族毁灭之前，你还要杀多少人？
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: That's...
chinese: 那是……

english: I serve the clan.
chinese: 我效忠氏族。

english: Please...let me help you start a village.
chinese: 请……让我帮你建起一个村子。

chinese: 这是 Sperri，你在上一个行省救下的农民之一。

english: Select him.
chinese: 选中他。

chinese: 屏幕下方显示的是可建造的建筑。

english: You can only build a peasant hut right now.
chinese: 现在你只能建农舍。

english: Left-click on the peasant hut icon, then place the hut by right-clicking somewhere on the ground.
chinese: 左键点击农舍图标，再在地面上选一处位置点击右键，建造农舍。

english: If you decide you don't want to build the hut right now, left-click to cancel or to select something else.
chinese: 若暂时不想建农舍，左键点击即可取消，也可选中别的东西。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: You can only build on relatively flat terrain, so plan carefully.
chinese: 只能在较平的地面上建造，所以要好好规划。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Excellent!
chinese: 很好！
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Remember, left-click is always cancel or select, and right-click always performs actions.
chinese: 记住，左键用于取消或选中，右键用于执行动作。

english: Look!  A new peasant has emerged from the hut we built.
chinese: 看！我们建的农舍里走出了一名新农民。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Now your people need food.
chinese: 现在你的人民需要食物。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Let's harvest some rice from that rice field over there.
chinese: 让我们从那边的稻田收些稻米。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Rice is the currency of this land and is used in all construction and training efforts.
chinese: 稻米在这里可作交换，也用于一切建造和训练。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Left-click one of the peasants, scroll to the rice field and right-click the rice field.
chinese: 左键选中一名农民，把画面移到稻田，再右键点击稻田。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Rice is important indeed, but you’ll also need water.
chinese: 稻米固然重要，但你还需要水。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: A pond or stream like that one would do nicely.
chinese: 那边的水池或河流就很好。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Select a peasant, then scroll to the pond and right-click it.
chinese: 选中一名农民，把画面移到水池，再右键点击。

english: Excellent!  We're almost ready to start building our army!
chinese: 很好！我们就快能组建军队了！

english: To train warriors, we'll need a Dojo.
chinese: 要训练战士，我们需要一座道场。

english: Select a peasant.
chinese: 选中一名农民。

english: Notice the Dojo is now available in the build menu.
chinese: 看，建造菜单中已经可以选择道场了。

english: Find a good spot and build the Dojo just like you built the peasant hut.
chinese: 找个合适的位置，像建农舍那样建起道场。

english: Now to train your first Spearman.
chinese: 现在来训练你的第一名长矛兵。

english: Select a peasant and right-click the Dojo.
chinese: 选中一名农民，右键点击道场。

english: Training Spearmen will cost you rice and water, so make sure some peasants keep harvesting.
chinese: 训练长矛兵要消耗稻米和水，记得让一些农民继续采集。

english: Well done - we're on our way!
chinese: 干得好，我们已经迈出第一步了！

english: The bandits must have driven these people out.
chinese: 匪徒一定赶走了这些人。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: But look - there's a peasant hut still standing!
chinese: 但你看，农舍还立着！
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: We should rebuild this village and make it our own.
chinese: 我们应该重建这个村子，让它成为我们的家。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: That's the last of them.
chinese: 最后一个也解决了。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: What?
chinese: 什么？
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: No, but...
chinese: 不，可是……
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: My uncle lived in this village.
chinese: 我有亲人住在这个村子。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: The Lotus clan.
chinese: 莲花族。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Look at the forest...how strange.
chinese: 看那片森林……真不寻常。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Kenji...is that you?
chinese: 健治……是你吗？

english: You've grown up.
chinese: 你长大了。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: He abuses your father's people.
chinese: 他残害你父亲的人民。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: His tax collectors take everything that's not nailed down, and...
chinese: 他派来征收的人把能拿走的都拿走了，而且……
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Since your father's death, the clan has fallen apart.
chinese: 你父亲死后，氏族就分崩离析了。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Only to save the peasants from...
chinese: 只是为了救农民脱离……
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: As you command.
chinese: 遵命。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Shinja's bandits drove these people out.
chinese: 信蛇的匪徒赶走了这些人。
status: draft; confirmed hero name; not game-tested

english: But look - there's still one peasant hut intact!
chinese: 但你看，还有一间农舍完好无损！

english: With your permission, I will claim it for the clan.
chinese: 如果你允许，我会替族人接管它。

english: A new peasant has just emerged from the peasant hut.
chinese: 一名新农民从农舍里出来了。

english: Select him.
chinese: 选中他。

english: Now you see the buildings the peasant can construct for you.
chinese: 现在可以看到农民能为你建造的建筑。

english: At the moment, you can only build another peasant hut or a target range.
chinese: 目前你只能再建一间农舍，或建一座靶场。

english: Left-click the target range icon, then right-click on the ground to place the new building.
chinese: 左键点击靶场图标，再右键点击地面放置新建筑。

english: You'll need additional rice and water to construct more buildings and train an army.
chinese: 要建更多建筑、训练军队，还需要更多稻米和水。

english: Select one peasant, then right-click on that rice field west of the village to begin harvesting rice.
chinese: 选中一名农民，再右键点击村西的稻田，让他开始收割。

english: There's also a stream to the north where we can obtain fresh water.
chinese: 北边还有一条小河，可以取到清水。

english: Send a peasant there as well.
chinese: 也派一名农民过去。

english: Now that we have a stockpile of rice and water, we should begin training some archers.
chinese: 现在稻米和水都有了，该开始训练弓箭手了。

english: Select a peasant, then right-click the target range.
chinese: 选中农民，再右键点击靶场。

english: Excellent!
chinese: 很好！

english: We must be careful.
chinese: 我们得小心。

english: We've taken Serpentholm - doesn't that matter?
chinese: 我们已经夺下 Serpentholm，这还不够吗？

chinese: 没时间再幻想什么魔法和龙了！

english: You must restore the Serpent clan!
chinese: 你必须让灵蛇族再次强大！

english: We have to move quickly, while the other clans are weak.
chinese: 趁其他族还弱，我们必须快点行动。

english: Kenji's gone, and I have an empire to build.
chinese: 健治已不在了，我得建立自己的帝国。

english: Here, look.
chinese: 来，看这里。

english: Serpentholm is safe for the moment.
chinese: Serpentholm 暂时安全。

english: We'll set the engineers to rebuilding the walls in case our enemies return.
chinese: 得派人重修城防，以防敌人回来。

english: The Wolf clan's army has retreated to the hills.
chinese: 恶狼族的军队退进了山里。

english: By now, they're preparing to make a stand at the mines.
chinese: 这会儿他们应该正准备在矿区坚守。

english: If we hurry, we might take them unprepared.
chinese: 动作够快，也许能打他们一个措手不及。

english: Perhaps rather than attempting a frontal assault, we should press them on the flank.
chinese: 与其正面强攻，不如从侧翼逼近。

english: The valleys and swamps in this province could hide our army until we're ready to strike.
chinese: 这一带的山谷和沼泽能掩护军队，直到我们发动进攻。

english: You're hurt.
chinese: 你受伤了。

english: Not too much pain for you, I hope.
chinese: 希望你没有太痛苦。

english: Our enemies understand pain and sacrifice.
chinese: 我们的敌人懂得痛苦，也懂得牺牲。

english: They're doomed, of course, but at least they don't cower in their villages.
chinese: 他们注定失败，但至少没有躲在村里不敢出来。

english: Say?
chinese: 你说什么？

english: I don't have anything to say.
chinese: 我没什么可说的。

english: Kenji's gone.
chinese: 健治已不在了。

english: The Serpent clan needs strong leaders, not weaklings.
chinese: 灵蛇族需要强者领导，不能交给软弱的人。

english: Take him.
chinese: 把他带走。

english: As you wish.
chinese: 遵命。

english: You take weaklings under your wing.
chinese: 你竟然把软弱的人收在身边。

english: To you?  Never.
chinese: 向你屈服？绝不。

english: As I served the father, so shall I serve the son.
chinese: 我怎样侍奉父亲，就怎样侍奉儿子。

english: At the Swan's Pool.
chinese: 在天鹅池。

english: Not me...the Serpent.
chinese: 不是我……是灵蛇。

english: You can't trust the townsfolk.
chinese: 镇上的人不能信。

english: They're mercenary scum who serve the highest bidder.
chinese: 那群唯利是图的家伙，谁出价高就为谁效力。

english: We'd be better off going west, crossing the river here.
chinese: 最好往西走，从这里过河。

english: There's a Wolf clan shanty town on the other side, but a few well-trained soldiers could easily clear away that rabble.
chinese: 对岸有个恶狼族的棚户区，派出训练有素的士兵就能轻易清掉那群人。

english: It's like old times - the Serpent clan fighting as one again.
chinese: 仿佛回到了从前，灵蛇族又能并肩作战了。

english: Kenji!
chinese: 健治！

english: A message from Riverside!
chinese: Riverside 送来了消息！

english: The Wolf clan is preparing to counterattack.
chinese: 恶狼族正准备反击。

english: We must head them off, or they'll sweep through the lowlands!
chinese: 必须挡住他们，不然他们会一路打到低地！

english: A large army of Lotus warriors is camped on the hillside below the warlock's tower.
chinese: 一支莲花族大军驻扎在术士塔下的山坡上。

english: We must attack, or they'll raid the southern coast!
chinese: 必须主动出击，否则他们会袭扰南部海岸！

english: I'll do it.
chinese: 我来办。

english: The other clans have come.
chinese: 其他各族也来了。

english: What is that?
chinese: 那是什么？

english: Our enemies are on the run.
chinese: 敌人正在溃逃。

english: Enough!
chinese: 够了！

english: Always have.
chinese: 一直如此。

english: What's your plan of attack?
chinese: 你打算怎么进攻？

english: This place stinks of death.
chinese: 这里满是死亡的气息。

english: Keep alert.
chinese: 保持警惕。

english: Something has taken them.
chinese: 有什么东西带走了他们。

english: You - you took the villagers.
chinese: 是你，你带走了村民。

english: Who asks?
chinese: 谁在问？

english: How?
chinese: 怎么会？

english: By killing his soldiers?
chinese: 靠杀掉他的士兵？

english: We have no need of your death magics.
chinese: 我们不需要你的死灵法术。

english: How could you know that?
chinese: 你怎么知道？

english: What do you want with Kenji?
chinese: 你找健治做什么？

english: If you're right about the Orb, Kenji will need every soldier he can get - even the dead ones.
chinese: 如果你说的宝珠是真的，健治会需要所有能找到的士兵——连死者也算。

english: Something's wrong.
chinese: 不对劲。

english: Otomo was supposed to be here by now.
chinese: 大友早该到了。

english: This province is already claimed.

english: Go before I kill you!

english: Industrious, aren't they?
chinese: 他们干活真勤快，不是吗？

english: They've spotted us!

english: We're close to the mines.
chinese: 我们离矿区不远了。

english: The Wolf miners burned the forest to clear trails for their carts.
chinese: 恶狼族的矿工烧掉树林，给车子开出道路。

english: Rally to me!

chinese: 为灵蛇族雪恨！

english: This province is already claimed.
chinese: 这一带已经有人占领。

english: If you have a quarrel with me, send your leader.

english: They've been busy.
chinese: 他们做了不少事。

english: Fight through to Serpentholm!
chinese: 一路杀到 Serpentholm！

english: A prize for the man who takes Otomo's head!

english: You've done well, Serpent's Son.
Ask your questions now.
It rests with the Lotus clan.
The Orb no longer matters.
Only the Lotus believe in its power.
Their faith gives it life.
Tarrant used the Orb to focus what was already within him.
Tarrant believed in its power, and his faith gave it life.
Of course.
You are the Serpent.  Become the Dragon.
Face evil and defeat it, as Tarrant did.
You have faced it before.
I am always here.
Why does the son of the Serpent come to this place?
Your father rejected me.
From the day he was born, the darkness kept him from the light.
He was never truly alive.
Are you different, Serpent's son?
So you know what you are not.
What are you?
What you want is not what you are.
First show me what you can do alone.
Meet me at the mountaintop, and I will answer your questions.
You are not the Serpent's son.
You are bound by your fears.
Let the darkness take you...
Four true men...
Sacrifice their blood...
Summon me.
Forget the Orb...
Become the Dragon...
Kenji!  Thank the heavens!
chinese: 健治！谢天谢地！

english: You're just in time.
The Lotus are at the bridges, and they've brought the ninja with them.
They're eager to settle old scores.
We owe you our lives, Lord Dragon.
No.
We'll have to circle back down and go through the mountains to reach them.
Stop!
You must not shed blood on holy ground!
We remember your father, and his father before him.
You are darker still.
Your war doesn't matter to us.
You may destroy a building, but you cannot destroy our faith.
I hear you.
Wasteful.
His army weakens.
We use the servant against the master.
Already done.
People die.
All.
The Orb does not matter.
I am always here.
He is different.
He is one with the Dragon.
Stop him now.
Take it.
You want to go home.
That is the Orb that traps you here.
That is the Orb that breaks the world.
That is the Orb that can get you home.
Take it.
We both fight the Serpent - that is all that matters.
I offer it only thrice.
Refuse again, and it goes to the Lotus.
Take it.
It's yours.
I am always here.
I cannot die.
We are always here!
Their time is over.
So is yours.
Look.
I am the Nightvol.
I am the dark.
I am always here.
His time is over.
So is yours.
Look.
I am the Nightvol.
I am the dark.
The Flame is in danger!
What is your bidding?
I don't have time to talk.
We need every man to protect the Soul Flame.
If the Wolf extinguish the Flame, we will be bound to them.
Follow me, then, but be careful.
There are some ninja who already serve the Wolf.
We belong to the Wolf now.
Kill the Serpent!
What's this?
We are betrayed - kill the Serpent!
What is your bidding?
We are in your debt.
Do you pay as well as your father did?
Watch where you step, noble one.
As long as the Soul Flame burns, the ninja are free to do as they will.
Who am I to upset the balance?
The souls of their victims burn deep in the swamp.
He who would rule the ninja must extinguish the flame.
I am Tao.
I am both dark and light.
If I am paid.
There - the Soul Flame.
Yes, I'll join you.
What would you have me do?
(Soft screaming)
chinese: （低声尖叫）

english: Ahh!  It burns!
chinese: 啊！好烫！

english: Oh, thank you!
chinese: 啊，谢谢你！

english: But where has all the forest gone?
chinese: 可是森林都去哪儿了？

english: I've slept too long!
chinese: 我睡得太久了！

english: Curse the miners - they'll pay for their carelessness!
chinese: 该死的矿工！他们要为自己的疏忽付出代价！

english: And the Lotus?
chinese: 莲花族呢？

english: Send Longtooth and his army to their fortress and tear it down.
chinese: 派 Longtooth 率军去他们的要塞，把它拆了。

english: It's time the Lotus learned what it's like to lose a home.
chinese: 该让莲花族尝尝失去家园的滋味了。

english: What of the Orb?
chinese: 宝珠怎么办？

english: We don't traffic with your kind.
chinese: 我们不跟你们这种人做交易。

english: We want to leave this land, but not at your price.
chinese: 我们想离开这片土地，但不会接受你的条件。

english: Why would you give it to us?
chinese: 你为什么要把它交给我们？

english: I told you, we don't traffic with...
chinese: 我说过，我们不跟……

english: The power to go home...
chinese: 回家的力量……

english: I'm not finished with you!  Come back!
chinese: 我们的事还没完！回来！

english: You're too late!
chinese: 你来晚了！

english: Look!
chinese: 看！

english: We're going home!
chinese: 我们要回家了！

english: The Wolf will never bow to the Serpent!
chinese: 恶狼族绝不会向蛇族低头！

english: (chortling laughter)
chinese: （得意地笑）

english: Kill them!
chinese: 杀了他们！

english: Grayback wants The Butcher's head!
chinese: 灰背要屠夫的人头！

english: The Serpent's son is driving us back, Lord Grayback.
chinese: 灰背大人，蛇族之子正把我们逼退。

english: They're finished.
chinese: 他们完了。

english: Zymeth threw everything he had against Serpentholm.
chinese: Zymeth 把全部兵力都投入了对灵蛇城的进攻。

english: What's left of the clan is scattered.
chinese: 族中残部四散奔逃。

english: The rumors are true.
chinese: 传闻是真的。

english: The dark one stole it before we could reach the keep.
chinese: 那个黑暗之人在我们赶到要塞前就把它偷走了。

english: ...the Serpent's Orb.
chinese: ……蛇族宝珠。

english: Gotcha.
chinese: 抓到你了。

english: There they are!  Kill them!
chinese: 他们在那儿！杀了他们！

english: Who let the snakes loose?
chinese: 是谁把那群蛇放出来的？

english: (loud laughter)
chinese: （放声大笑）

english: I've found a scroll!
chinese: 我找到一张卷轴！

english: Slither home, little ones!
chinese: 爬回家去吧，小蛇们！

english: Ahh…the infidels...right where Mistress Yvaine said they would be.
chinese: 啊……异教徒……果然就在 Yvaine 女主人说的地方。

Not yet, but we have little time…

Longtooth will bring reinforcements from the other shale mines.

Yvaine and the corrupted totem are nothing but ashes now.

Mmm…rice.
Long ago, life was better for the Wolf Clan.
Our ancestors lived on a faraway island, in peace and harmony.
They took care of the land, and the land gave them everything they needed.
Everything was simple and good…
…until the storms came, and drowned our paradise.
Our ancestors' simple magic was powerless to stop the destruction.
They knew only that they had to flee…or perish.
They never understood the disaster that almost destroyed them.
Half a world away, the Serpent Clan's founder used his Orb to reshape the world.
That act of desperation disrupted the balance of nature, and doomed our home.
But how could our forefathers have imagined the source of their troubles?
And how could they guess where their desperate prayers would take them?
Using our clan's most sacred totem, the White Wolf's Skull, our Druidess Order rescued us from death.
The totem brought us here, to the lands of the Serpent Empire.
Thankful for our salvation, we rebuilt our towns and our lives.
Our new neighbors, the devious Serpent and cold-hearted Lotus, welcomed us as allies and promised us safety.
Unfortunately, we trusted them.
For generations, our Clan tried to return to the simple life it left behind.
Our numbers slowly recovered, and our villages grew and thrived.
Everything seemed simple and good again…
Until a new disaster broke over our people -- a disaster of betrayal and fire.
Lord Zymeth of the Lotus Clan made a deal with the treacherous Serpent emperor, and attacked us by surprise.
The Serpent looked the other way as the Lotus slaughtered our farmers and burned our homes.
Like the rest of my brothers, I fought to save our Clan, and I could not.
The survivors of that battle have been slaves in the Lotus shale mines ever since.
For seven years, we've worked and died to make the Lotus wealthy.
The Lotus slavemaster, Mistress Yvaine, rules our Clan through fear.
She believes we have lost the ability to dream of freedom.
She is wrong.
I am Grayback, last heir to the Wolf Clan's throne.
For seven years, I've trained my fellow miners in the arts of war.
Hammers, picks and stones are our weapons…those, and our unending anger.
A third disaster is coming -- a disaster for the murderers who dared to cross us.
Soon, the Wolf Clan will rise again.
It is the Skull of the White Wolf -- a relic of our clan's guardian spirit.
Until our war against the Lotus, it was our greatest treasure.
Only Gaihla and her Druidess Order knew how to harness its powers.
If they were alive, maybe they could tell us how to stop the Totem.
But they died in the final battle.
How can that be?
Then we must find her.
Gather the troops -- we're leaving at once.
Another brave man has fallen.
I hope he finds freedom.
You're right…we'd better keep moving.
Any enemy of the Lotus is welcome in my camp.
The Shale Lord fights with us.
Then I'll take the Skull of the White Wolf from her.
Yvaine will expect me…I won't ask any of you to follow me into her traps.
You don't have to call me that…
Thank you, my friends.
Can anyone hear me? Help!
Yvaine's had me locked in this stinking cell for days.
A few more seconds and I would've been torn to shreds!
You can count on me always, my Lord!
We've beaten her, Lord!
We've almost reached the main tunnels, Grayback.
Watch out -- I've seen that gas before.
It seeps up from the rocks, and can kill a man in seconds.
What's worse, it's explosive.
Over here, Grayback!
What's behind this barrier?
We can't give up…there must be a way around this barrier.
Daylight! It's been so long…
But that's suicidal!
You'll never beat Yvaine by yourself!
And if we return to find you dead…
The other mines will be free before the Lotus know what hit them.
I won't let you down!
Fight like the Wolf!
Looks like there's some kind of commotion in the town…
The Serpent Witches are famous practitioners of black magic.
I'm not surprised they're doing Yvaine's dirty work.
Looks like the end of the road.
Looks like she's set up plenty of those magic walls to slow us down.
She wields the powers of a god…I don't think it'll be that easy.
I thought I was finished with filthy, Lotus-smelling caves.
Are you insane?
You want me to share a throne with this maniac?
You'd better come back alive, Grayback.
Wait…are those Serpent troops at the bottom of the mountain?
More Serpent troops are climbing the mountain! We must reach Yvaine!
I'm telling you, Grayback's in trouble!
We've got to go after him!
But he can't do this alone! He needs us!
They don't have to be his last orders!
I'm not waiting any longer…
Grayback! Noooooo…!
…I guess he didn't need us after all…
So is our leader.
I should have gone after him…
He's alive! Grayback is alive!
I knew you'd make it, Lord!
He won't try soon! We must have slain half his army on this mountain.
All hail Lord Grayback!
The Totem must be very powerful to create such a storm.
What is it, anyway?
Do you think Gaihla could help us, Wildeye?
If Gaihla can't stop this storm, we'll join him soon enough.
Yes, but can we trust what he's become?
What do you think, Grayback?
Gaihla, the weather is getting worse.
Can you help us stop Yvaine's winter?
Why would any of us abandon you now, Lord Grayback?
There's no way we can fight off an army!
But how will he find us?
(wild cheering)
So cold…
I'm sorry, Grayback, but you'll never win against the Lotus.
You offer us nothing but death…and Budo offered us food.
chinese: 你给我们的只有死路……武堂至少给我们米。

english: Please don't take me back to the cage!
It's our leader! Thanks, Grayback!
Grayback, we thought you were dead!
We're too few in number!
No problem, boss!
Wait…there's someone approaching from the East…
Yes, it's Longtooth! And there's a whole army of Wolves behind him!
There's a small town in the southwest…I see slaves in the fields.
And there's a great fortress in the southeast, blocking a pass through the mountains.
(angry bellowing)
I'm so hungry…
Since Budo started ordering us around, I've hardly eaten a thing!
chinese: 武堂开始使唤我们以后，我都没能好好进食！

english: Do you think Mistress Yvaine is starting to trust us, Grayback?
Ha! Fighting's the easiest thing in the world!
It's pretending to be weak that's driving me crazy!
Yeah, but what about our dinner?
I'm starving!
What about my dinner?
I can't! I'm so hungry, I'm about to fall over!
Look at this, Grayback! It's amazing!
What is it?
It's Mistress Yvaine!
Don't hurt us! Budo told us there was shale down here!
chinese: 别伤害我们！武堂说这里有页岩！

english: We didn't touch your magic stuff...promise!
This isn't an ordinary punishment, Grayback!
I have a bad feeling about this…
Grayback, it's a trap!
Right behind you, boss!
Grayback's come for us! Hooray!
We heard fighting, but we couldn't open the gate!
The Lotus have a bunch of these rice bins stashed down here.
Free us, and we'll bust 'em open for you!
So the trappers were trapped, and the murderers slain!
Congratulations, Grayback, on a battle well fought!
My name is Tao.
I am both Monk and Ninja. Half Light, half Darkness.
I serve Yin and Yang, and the Balance of all things.
At the moment, the Yin of the Lotus is very strong -- it threatens the land itself.
By protecting this Monastery, I strengthen the Yang and serve the Balance.
The Monks were not harmed, and Grayback's heroes arrived safely.
I think I protected them very well!
Correction -- only half mad.
Yvaine owes her blood to the Lord of the Wolves. It is not mine to spill.
But I am a master of roads and journeys, and I can help you reach your goal.
Listen closely, and I will give you the secrets you need…
The road to Yvaine is blocked by two magical gateways.
These are maintained by a pair of rival archmages, Issyl and Koril.
Issyl and Koril despise each other. They never cooperate on anything.
If you defeat them both quickly, you'll slip right through their gates.
But beware! If you kill only Issyl, then Koril will take control of his armies.
Likewise, Issyl would be quick to take advantage of Koril's demise.
Either way, if you let them combine their forces, you're in for a tough fight!
Now, I must depart. The Balance calls me to other lands.
Fight well, Grayback! We both have unfinished duties in this world!
Now I'll never avenge my murdered family…
Pain, eh? I could show you a thing or two about that…
Aye, it's good to see a friendly face around here.
I'm a Wolf, all right, but I've never been in those stinking mines.
My allies in the forest kept me well-hidden after the war.
The Lotus destroyed my family and my home, but they couldn't catch Wildeye!
I've been stalking and killing those devils ever since.
Are you kidding? I've waited seven years to hear those words!
You're the one who's dying today, witch!
Seven years ago, you murdered my mate and my cubs.
But you wouldn't remember that, would you?
We're too late! How could the Lotus have beaten us here?
What? Gaihla's Sanctuary has frozen over?
But Gaihla's magic has always protected her lands from the winter…
Ha! Some lady!
Kill you? We thought we'd turn you over to the Dryads.
They're sure they can talk you into changing your evil ways.
And they're willing to spend a long, long time doing it…
Cutting her open?
My wolves can find anything. Let's go!
…I wonder what Utara meant by 'abominations'…?
He's saying the same thing my wolves tell me…that Gaihla's trail ends here.
No, the wolves would smell her blood.
Someone's coming through the woods!
Huh? Where did this Wolf Clansman come from?
Something terrible is happening here…
I'd better stalk these two and see if they lead me to Gaihla.
Can't let them see me, or I'll never find out where they're heading!
Curses…we've lost them! Now we'll never find Gaihla!
There's nothing here. Are they mad?
Unbelievable! The Lotus have built themselves an invisible town!
I'll bet my mustache that Gaihla's down there somewhere.
You're right...what if this place disappears again?
I bet that magic tower is what makes this town invisible.
If only we could destroy it before the Lotus can use it again…
Good idea! If we roll boulders onto their buildings, they'll panic for sure!
That'll buy enough time for Grayback to hear the commotion and find us.
He'll know what to do.
Huh? What's wrong?
What in the world is that thing? It's monstrous!
Gah! We've been surrounded by more of those disgusting monsters!
We can't let them stop us…it's time to roll some rocks!
Hey, it seems to be attacking that magic tower!
What a way to go…ripped apart by a pack of midgets.
Of course not!
Let's rescue Gaihla!
Lady Gaihla? Are you all right?
We've lost them…now we'll never find Gaihla!
A glorious battle, but there's nobody left to follow…we'll never find Gaihla now!
I'm dying…forgive me, Gaihla…
The town vanished again! We've lost our chance to save Gaihla!
Shouldn't get too close until Grayback arrives…I'd better just keep pushing boulders.
Lady Gaihla! You look terrible!
Grayback, what's wrong with her?
There's an abandoned monastery, but I have a bad feeling about that…
There's not a soul in sight, but the gardens are well-tended.
Yeah, and it's also the only shelter for miles around.
Follow me, milady…we're almost to safety.
What happened to the monks who lived here?
Gaihla is resting in the Monastery -- the Monks have promised to heal her.
But this odd fellow won't leave me alone…
But you couldn't even protect the Monks from Utara's mercenaries!
And I think you're completely mad!
Our witchcraft? This is Yvaine's work, you dunce!
I bet that pansy would run screaming from a real fight.
Let's tear down his Royal Academies…he won't be so tough without his bodyguards.
The Academies will be lightly defended, as long as we steer clear of Taro's main forces.
If we destroy all three Academies, Taro will know we mean business.
Are you stupid? Look at us! We're freezing out here!
Do you really think dirty savages like us know such powerful spells?
We're not magicians, we're miners, you dolt!
Let's finish this.
By all the gods, it's cold! I can't even feel my mustache!
What happens when we reach Yvaine? Do we just kill her?
We are not leaving you now!
Us? Rulers? You are insane.
Hope he knows what he's doing…
Gaihla is right, my friend.
We must not dishonor Grayback's last orders.
Look! The snow is stopping!
What was that blast? We thought you were a goner!
And the other half can wait until Spring!
All hail the Lord of the Wolves!
In all my years, I've never seen a blizzard like this.
I don't mind a little snow, but this stuff is cold as death!
Ha ha! You're not the first to think so!
Not everyone who disappeared in that battle was lost, Grayback.
Gaihla is alive, and her Druidesses, too!
The woods-walkers have ways of hiding from their enemies.
They're still living in the old swamps, waiting for us to return.
She knows more of the ancient ways than any living Wolf.
If Gaihla can't figure out how to stop this nasty weather, nobody can.
He fights like a behemoth! I say we're lucky he's on our side.
That black-hearted sorceress still owes me a debt of blood. I'm coming.
Gaihla's right. We're your pack.
And we'll fight by your side until the end.
